My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
If your tracking indicates delivered but you have not received the package, please follow these steps:
Check around the delivery location: Inspect doors, side entrances, mailrooms, front desks, parcel lockers, or ask neighbors in case the carrier left the package nearby.
Wait a short time and refresh tracking: Carriers may occasionally mark a package as delivered before it actually arrives, and it may be delivered later the same day.
Use the tracking link from your shipping confirmation email: Tracking information is typically included in the shipping confirmation email sent after your order ships.
If you are signed in, you can check your latest order status here: The system can provide your latest order, order status, and tracking information when you are signed in.
If tracking has not updated or the package still does not appear, contact our customer service team: NANUK’s customer service contact details are as follows:
Email: info@nanuk.com
Phone: 1-800-783-6883
For your reference, the shipping page states that consumer orders usually ship within 2 days, and once shipped, regular orders typically use UPS Ground.
